Luka Dončić continues making NBA history! With 40 PTS, 9 REB, 7 AST and 6 3PM, Luka extended his record-breaking streak to six consecutive games with at least 35 PTS, 5 REB, 5 AST and 5 3PM, the longest in NBA history. He also became just the fourth player ever to score 300+ points through his first eight games of a season, reaching 308 points and becoming the first to do so since Michael Jordan in 1988-89!
